subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Which open candidate should be treated as canonical for the preflight compaction retryability fix?
rationale: The issue is source-proven and has multiple open linked PRs with different retryability tradeoffs, so starting another automated repair lane would add duplication.

options.title: Use the narrowed runtime PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101241 as the canonical path after real behavior proof or a maintainer proof override.

options.title: Repair the classifier-split PR
options.body: Continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101285 only if its 429 billing/setup-classification blocker is fixed.

options.title: Switch to UI recovery
options.body: Pause runtime fail-open changes and ask for a Control UI recovery fix if maintainers do not want preflight compaction failures skipped.

recommendation.title: Use the narrowed runtime PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101241 as the canonical path after real behavior proof or a maintainer proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: He provided the prior same-root retryability guidance and is already directly requested in the issue discussion.
